title: Formal scope: what the Lean catalogue establishes and defers
html:
Formal scope

What is established:

  • The named function delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_witness : ℕ → ℚ in Lean, which catalogues the coefficients c_0, \dots, c_7 in the canonical (borromean) frame, matching the witness. Its theorems are reflexivity on the table and prove nothing about the surrogate itself.
  • Sorry-free theorems about delta_tau_M_surrogate itself at every order 0 to 7: vanishing at q = 1, the first derivative -5/6, orders 2 and 3 by explicit quotient-rule derivative towers, and orders 4 to 7 by an iterated-Leibniz recurrence on the polynomial identity f \cdot D = N.

What is deferred:

  • A closed-form recursion for the c_n. The canonical surrogate is a rational function with a degree-17 numerator and the degree-10 denominator 4q^8(q^2+q+1), so a finite-order linear recursion on c_n exists, but extracting it remains open.
